result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line has overlapping text, making the delivery time and fee unreadable. The rest of the page renders correctly; partially visible carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom are expected.

issues.description: The metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows two text strings drawn on top of each other. The delivery time ('25–35 min') and the delivery fee ('€0 delivery') occupy the same position, producing garbled text ('25–3€0mdienlivery'). Users cannot read the estimated delivery time or the fee.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the time and fee as sequential inline elements separated by a bullet, as on other cards (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'). Remove any absolute positioning or overlay that places both at the same origin, and verify the row wraps or truncates gracefully on narrow screens.
